findings.quote: while you and other companions continue at normal speed
findings.why: invented flavor with no counterpart in the original prose

findings.quote: it cannot perceive the outside world, cannot take actions, cannot speak or be spoken to, and is not aware of what happens outside
findings.why: original states only 'completely cut off from outside stimuli' — this is a punched-up enumeration invented beyond that single clause (list-ification)

findings.quote: The cocoon's HP increases to 40 and its Hardness increases to 10, and the cocoon is visually imperceptible; a creature must succeed at a DC 30 Perception check to notice it.
findings.why: keep: genuinely different effect (adds invisibility + detection DC), not a pure numeric ladder; original had no entriesHigherLevel at all so new scaling was unavoidable

findings.quote: The transformation takes 1 minute of sustained physical contact.
findings.why: invented duration: the 5e original's initial cast is 1 action (only REVERTING took 1 minute); this also contradicts the store's own 2-action cast time field

findings.quote: the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} and can't use the Stride action
findings.why: condition mapping beyond T8's stated exemplars — original's 'incapacitated and can't move' mapped to Slowed 1, a judgment call worth stakeholder confirmation rather than freelancing

findings.quote: The reversion time is reduced to 1 action.
findings.why: loosens a time limit — matches the brief's struck 'tiers relaxing a time limit' anti-pattern; candidate for removal

findings.quote: The resistance increases to 10. The target can also pass through locked doors and windows, but not magically sealed ones, without opening them.
findings.why: keep: genuinely different capability (locked-door passage), not pure numeric bloat

findings.quote: Creatures in the cone take 8d10 void damage from the ravaging decomposition with a basic Fortitude save.
findings.why: the 5e original deals NO direct damage to creatures at all — only a Con save that destroys gear, plus a separate Con-drain for undead; this is an invented damage mechanic layered on top of the original design

findings.quote: Undead take an additional 4d10 void damage.
findings.why: original's undead penalty is a permanent Constitution-score loss (ability drain), which is exactly what PF2e's Drained condition models; converting it to flat bonus damage instead is a judgment call worth flagging rather than freelancing

findings.quote: The base void damage increases by 1d10.
findings.why: keep: pure damage-ladder collapse matching the Diamond Dust exemplar exactly

findings.quote: (Interact + Cast a Spell)
findings.why: explaining parenthetical spelling out the activity's components — official spells don't gloss 2-action activities inline like this

findings.quote: For the duration, any creature that hits you with a melee Strike takes 2d6 acid damage.
findings.why: original also grants 'you gain resistance to acid damage' as self-protection from your own vapor — that whole clause is missing from the store version

findings.quote: This attack ends the aura immediately; the vapor is entirely consumed.
findings.why: invented flavor beyond the original's plain 'a hit... ends this spell'

findings.quote: The aura's retaliation damage increases by 1d6, and the focused attack damage increases by 2d6.
findings.why: keep: standard pure damage-ladder heightening across two damage instances

findings.quote: from the plane of Gehenna
findings.why: Gehenna is a named D&D outer plane (from the original 5e text too) — needs a <Gehenna|alias> pair, e.g. <Gehenna|a plane of ceaseless corrosive torment>

findings.quote: A creature within range is damaged by an attack or effect.
findings.why: original's trigger is specifically a creature 'being the target of an attack' — adding 'or effect' widens the trigger scope beyond the source

findings.quote: The target must attempt a Will save against your spell DC.
findings.why: a whole second mechanic from the original is missing: 'if the creature made a saving throw as part of the previous attack and succeeded, it must remake the saving throw with disadvantage or suffer the original effects' — this escalation clause was dropped entirely, not just this sentence

findings.quote: The maximum echoed damage increases by 6.
findings.why: keep: pure ladder matching exemplar

findings.quote: The circumstance bonus to the triggering save increases to +3, and you can also grant the bonus to one adjacent ally who is also targeted by the same effect.
findings.why: keep: genuinely different capability (extends the bonus to an ally), not pure numeric bloat

findings.quote: You speak a short sonic invocation and strike with your melee weapon, weaving a lattice of compressed space around the target.
findings.why: the original opens directly with the mechanic ('As a part of the action used to cast this spell...') — this whole scene-setting sentence is invented flavor with no counterpart

findings.quote: the target is marked with a destabilized spatial resonance until the start of your next turn
findings.why: original just says 'the space around the target is slightly distorted' — 'destabilized spatial resonance' is invented jargon

findings.quote: The decompression damage increases by 1d4.
findings.why: keep: pure damage-ladder matching exemplar; correctly mirrors the original's cantrip character-level scaling (5th/11th/17th)

findings.quote: compresses a layer of air to the density of tempered steel
findings.why: original just says the air becomes 'solid' — 'density of tempered steel' is an invented specific simile

findings.quote: The resistance increases by 5.
findings.why: keep: pure numeric ladder matching exemplar

findings.quote: (it may attempt this save at the end of each of its turns)
findings.replacement: attempting this save at the end of each of its turns
findings.why: load-bearing timing rule left parenthesized instead of promoted to plain prose

findings.quote: The next time you hit a creature with a melee Strike using the infused weapon before this spell ends, you deal an additional 3d10 force damage.
findings.why: original's bonus applies only to 'the first time you hit... during this turn' — the store widens the window to any hit before the spell ends, a scope change

findings.quote: The curse ends when the spell ends or when the creature succeeds at a Will saving throw against your spell DC
findings.why: original's curse has no escape mechanism at all (ends only when the spell ends) — this repeated-save escape clause is invented, and doesn't follow T3's one-sentence counteract-check convention for curse removal either

findings.quote: your blade cutting through the intervening space
findings.why: invented flavor beyond the original's plain 'regardless of distance or obstacles'

findings.quote: The initial bonus damage increases by 1d10, and the per-hit curse damage increases by 1d6.
findings.why: keep: pure ladder across two damage instances, matches exemplar

findings.quote: (but not suicidal action)
findings.why: load-bearing behavioral limit left parenthesized instead of promoted to plain prose

findings.quote: If you cease leading or give contradictory orders, the effect ends for that creature.
findings.why: original also states the consequence 'the spell ends and the crowd becomes hostile toward you' — that whole risk clause is missing from the store version

findings.quote: The range and emanation increase to 120 feet, and you need not be present to maintain the compulsion; affected creatures pursue the goal autonomously for the duration.
findings.why: keep: genuinely different capability (autonomous pursuit), not pure numeric bloat

findings.quote: The object or surface appears virgin to all mundane inspection.
findings.why: original's plainer 'appears to have never been written on' — 'virgin' is an unnecessary register punch-up

findings.quote: You can erase magical writing from prepared scrolls and formula books; a magical scroll erased this way is destroyed without activating.
findings.why: keep: genuinely different capability tier, necessary new scaling since the original had no entriesHigherLevel at all

findings.quote: You can erase runes and property runes inscribed on weapons and armor; each rune erased is permanently destroyed.
findings.why: keep: genuinely different capability tier

findings.quote: You open a conduit to the space between planes, firing a beam of pulsing violet-white light harvested from the interplanar void.
findings.why: original's plainer 'You fire a beam of pulsing violet light harvested from the space between planes' — 'conduit'/'interplanar void' is an invented register punch-up

findings.quote: The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled]{Dazzled} until the start of your next turn.
findings.why: original's blinded creature gets a repeated Constitution save each turn to shake it off early — the store replaced that escalating recovery design with a flat fixed duration

findings.quote: The damage increases by 1d12.
findings.why: keep: pure ladder matching exemplar

findings.quote: The target can spend an action to attempt a Fortitude save to reduce the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened} condition by 1.
findings.why: restates the Sickened condition's own default recovery rule (retching to reduce sickened by 1) — a positive restatement of a rules default

findings.quote: On a critical hit with the attack roll, the Fortitude save is made at a -2 status penalty.
findings.why: invented complexity with no counterpart in the original, which has a plain repeated-save recovery and no attack-crit interaction

findings.quote: The vitality damage increases by 2d6.
findings.why: keep: pure ladder matching exemplar

findings.quote: Drawing a new circle requires 1 day and 250 gp, while empowering a previously placed circle takes only 1 minute.
findings.why: original also describes the circle's physical form ('a flat design of a geometric shape with a 5-foot radius') and the sigil's size/behavior ('reappears when you are scrying through it... no more than an inch in diameter') — those descriptive/mechanical details are dropped

findings.quote: You can link one additional sigil per casting beyond your Intelligence modifier, and you can switch between sigils as a free action instead of an Interact action.
findings.why: keep: genuinely different capability, necessary new scaling since the original had no entriesHigherLevel

findings.quote: if no such space is within 30 feet, you are squeezed out over 1 round and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute from the traumatic reconstitution

findings.quote: dissolving your solid body into an animated mass of thick, viscous liquid that retains your mass and volume but becomes fully amorphous

findings.quote: The resistance increases to 15 and you also gain resistance 10 to acid damage. You can flow up walls and across ceilings, gaining a 20-foot climb Speed.
